notice.title: Videos are free
notice.body: All video lessons are free to watch on YouTube. Payments here buy Mastemy study services only (notes, question banks, mock exams, analytics and stated AI allowances) — never video access.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.countryHint: Two-letter code, e.g. DE or SA.
checkout.currencyNote: Only currencies with an approved price for this package are listed.
checkout.noPaymentNeeded: Nothing to pay: your access is granted as soon as you confirm.
checkout.serverPrice: The price is calculated by Mastemy's server; the amount charged is the total shown.
checkout.referralUsed: Referral code {code} will be credited to the instructor.
checkout.referralDropped: The referral code does not apply to this purchase and was removed.
checkout.affiliateDropped: The partner referral is no longer valid and was removed.

gift.title: Gift
gift.explain: You receive a one-time code after payment; the recipient redeems it at /gift/redeem.
gift.recipientHint: If set, the code is emailed to the recipient and never shown to you.
gift.redeemSubtitle: Enter the gift code you received to unlock the study services.
gift.redeemedBody: Your study services are active until {date}.
gift.showOnce: A gift code is shown only once. Make sure you can copy it now. Orders that are not gifts have no code.
gift.notAGift: This order is not a gift.

plans.title: Subscription plans
plans.subtitle: Study services across courses, billed by Stripe. Cancel any time; access lasts to the end of the paid period.
plans.none: No plans are offered right now.
plans.aiAllowance: AI allowance: {n} requests per billing period

bundles.title: Bundles
bundles.subtitle: Several study packages for one price.
bundles.none: No bundles are available right now.

orders.title: Orders & invoices
orders.paidBody: No payment was needed; your access is active.
orders.refundRemaining: This requests a refund of the remaining (not yet refunded) amount of the order, within the refund window. Finance reviews every request.

invoices.title: Invoices and credit notes
invoices.notConfigured: PDF invoices are not available yet: the seller details have not been configured on this server. The invoice record above is still valid.

subs.title: Subscription
subs.grace: Your last renewal payment failed. Update your payment method with Stripe; access continues until {date}.
subs.cancelExplain: You will not be charged again. Access continues until {date}; you can resume before then.
subs.cancelled: Your subscription will end at the end of the period.

studio.title: Pricing & coupons
studio.subtitle: Coupons, regional prices, scheduled offers and referral links for your own courses.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.policyCap: Instructor coupons are capped by the platform's maximum discount; the server rejects anything above it and states the limit.
coupons.policyScope: Coupons apply only to your own courses or packages, to the regular price.
coupons.policyScholarship: Scholarship codes (100% off, restricted to named emails or domains) need approval by a staff member other than you.
coupons.policyNoStack: One coupon per order; a coupon never stacks with a running offer and must beat it.
coupons.createdPending: Coupon {code} is waiting for staff approval.

prices.title: Regional prices
prices.explain: Propose a price in another currency or for specific countries. It is used at checkout only after staff approve it.
prices.countriesHint: Optional two-letter codes, comma-separated. Empty means every country.
prices.noPackages: You have no approved packages yet.

offers.title: Scheduled offers
offers.explain: Staff schedule platform offers with a fixed end time. Opting in requires a regular price that has been stable for at least 30 of the last 90 days.

referrals.title: Referral links
referrals.explain: Share a course link with your referral code. Purchases made through it pay the referral instructor share.
referrals.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the link and copy it manually.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.subtitle: Payout profile, cleared balance, payout requests and monthly statements.
payouts.noProfile: You have not set up a payout profile.
payouts.maskedNote: Your bank account or email is stored encrypted and only shown masked. Re-enter it to change the profile.
payouts.taxSubmitted: I have submitted my tax form
payouts.balancesExplain: Earnings clear once the refund window has passed. You can request the whole cleared balance once it reaches the minimum and your tax form is verified.

finance.title: Finance console
finance.subtitle: Refunds, chargebacks, reconciliation, payouts, invoices and tax rates.
finance.refundExplain: Partial or full refund up to the remaining amount. A credit note is issued. Entitlements are revoked on a full refund, or on a partial one when you choose so.
finance.amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
finance.amountDecimals: Use at most two decimal places.
finance.revoke: Also revoke access for a partial refund
finance.revokeHint: A full refund always revokes access.
finance.refunded: Refund of {amount} completed; credit note issued.
finance.learnerRequestsHint: Learner requests are approved or rejected under Admin › Refunds.
finance.disputesExplain: Chargebacks are reported by Stripe. The instructor share is frozen while open; a lost dispute revokes access.
finance.reconExplain: Per UTC day and currency: provider payments compared with the ledger. Range up to 93 days.
finance.batchesExplain: A draft batch must be approved by a different finance user.
finance.instructorIdHint: Enter an instructor ID to download their monthly statement.
finance.taxExplain: Rates are used only when the server runs in tax-inclusive mode. There are no built-in rates.

affiliates.title: Affiliates
affiliates.name: Name
affiliates.percentHint: Paid from the platform share; capped by platform policy.

staff.title: Commerce
staff.subtitle: Plans, bundles, scheduled offers, scholarship approvals and regional prices.
staff.planRules: Plans sell study services only. Text that advertises video access or 'unlimited' use is rejected. Price, interval and scope cannot change after creation.
staff.planImmutable: Price, interval and scope are fixed.
staff.bundleRules: All packages must be approved and in the same currency; the bundle price must be lower than the sum of the parts.
staff.activeBundlesNote: Only active bundles are listed by the API.
staff.offerRules: Offers run at most 31 days and apply only to packages whose instructor opted in. The real end time is shown to buyers; there are no countdowns.
staff.secondPerson: A scholarship code must be approved by someone other than the person who created it. Your own pending codes cannot be approved by you.
staff.pricesExplain: Approving a regional price retires the previous approved price for the same currency and countries and records price history.

errors.coupon_invalid: This coupon code is not valid.
errors.coupon_not_started: This coupon is not active yet.
errors.coupon_not_applicable: This coupon does not apply to this purchase.
errors.coupon_min_amount: The order is below this coupon's minimum amount.
errors.coupon_currency_mismatch: This coupon is for a different currency.
errors.coupon_exhausted: This coupon has been fully used.
errors.coupon_already_used: You have already used this coupon.
errors.coupon_not_eligible: Your account is not eligible for this scholarship code.
errors.coupon_self_use: You cannot use a coupon on your own course.
errors.coupon_does_not_stack: The running offer is already better than this coupon; coupons do not stack with offers.
errors.coupon_code_taken: A coupon with this code already exists.
errors.scholarship_unrestricted: Scholarship codes must be restricted to emails, domains or an organization.
errors.payments_not_configured: Payments are not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.payment_provider_error: The payment provider did not confirm the request. Nothing was changed; please retry.
errors.idempotency_key_reused: This checkout was already started with different details. Reload the page and try again.
errors.already_subscribed: You already have an active subscription.
errors.gift_invalid: This gift code is not valid.
errors.gift_void: This gift is no longer valid.
errors.gift_already_redeemed: This gift has already been redeemed.
errors.gift_code_already_revealed: The gift code was already shown once and cannot be shown again.
errors.gift_code_emailed: The gift code was emailed to the recipient.
errors.gift_bundle_not_supported: Bundles cannot be bought as gifts.
errors.subscription_refund_not_supported: Subscription payments are not refunded through this form; cancel at period end instead.
errors.nothing_to_refund: Nothing is left to refund on this order.
errors.refund_exceeds_remaining: The amount is more than what remains refundable on this order.
errors.invoicing_not_configured: PDF invoices are not available yet: the seller details have not been configured on this server.
errors.subscription_not_active: This subscription cannot be changed in its current state.
errors.payout_profile_incomplete: Complete your payout profile and have your tax form verified first.
errors.below_minimum_payout: Your cleared balance is below the minimum payout.
errors.reference_price_not_established: Your regular price has not been stable for 30 of the last 90 days, so this package cannot join the offer yet.
errors.bundle_price_not_lower: The bundle price must be lower than the sum of its packages.
errors.package_sells_video_access: Text may not advertise video access: videos are always free.
errors.unlimited_claim: Plans may not claim 'unlimited' use; state exact allowances.
errors.payout_request_decided: Some of these payout requests were already decided.
errors.editor_scope: Editors cannot change pricing; ask the course owner.
errors.package_unavailable: This package is not available for purchase.
errors.bundle_unavailable: This bundle is not available for purchase.
